titleHtml:
On the Trail of
Tom Thomson,
100 years later.
heroAlt: Canoe as a painting table on the trail in Algonquin Park
fieldNote: This page explores my three years journey retracing the trails of Canadian iconic artist Tom Thomson and his time in Canada’s Algonquin Park.
This journey isn’t just about Thomson, it is also about me and my experiences in art. What I learned and observed along the way.
